_README: Declared provenance for every vendored artefact under source/extern (ledger row E10).
HAND-EDITED. scripts/extern-provenance.py checks it against the tree and generates the table;
it is a REGISTER, not documentation -- the doc is derived from it and must never be edited directly.
Why declared at all: upstream, licence and why-vendored cannot be derived from a vendored copy.
Everything that CAN be derived is derived and CROSS-CHECKED, so a stale entry fails the gate rather
than sitting there being wrong. That is the whole point: PR 570's own extern/README.md contradicted
their vcpkg.json on its first policy bullet, on the day it landed (ledger row B12).
paths        every file/dir this artefact owns, relative to source/extern. The union across all
entries must equal the directory listing exactly -- no orphans, no phantoms.
version      declared. If `version_from` is present the script DERIVES it and the two must agree.
version_from {file, macros} -- macros are #define names joined with '.' in the order given.
reach        how the artefact gets into the binary. Derived and cross-checked:
conditional  named in star_extern_SOURCES inside an IF() -- give `condition`
header       named in star_extern_HEADERS (compiled only where included)
indirect     not named; #included by a compiled translation unit -- give `included_by`
include_path not named anywhere; #included by our own source outside source/extern
unreachable  named nowhere and included by nothing. DEAD -- justify or delete.

lua.why: The scripting language the entire mod surface is written against. Vendored by upstream Starbound; the interpreter is not swappable for a packaged one without changing script semantics.

fmt.why: Formatting for strf/Logger across the whole tree. Vendored rather than packaged so the format-string ABI cannot shift under a vcpkg baseline bump mid-campaign.

xxhash.why: Content hashing for the render caches and the harness frame hash. xxh3.h is reached from source/core/StarXXHash.hpp via the include path, NOT through CMakeLists -- it is live despite being named in no build list.

curve25519.why: Ed25519 signing and X25519 key exchange for the network handshake. No release tags in the vendored drop, so no version is derivable and none is claimed.

fast_float.why: Locale-independent string-to-float used by the Json parser. Header-only single file; the vendored copy carries no version macro.

rpmalloc.why: Optional allocator, one of three (jemalloc / mimalloc / rpmalloc). malloc.c is the operator-new shim and is NOT in any CMake list -- rpmalloc.c #includes it, so it compiles only through that.

imgui_lua_bindings.why: Exposes the debug ImGui surface to Lua. The vendored copy carries NO licence header, which is a genuine attribution gap rather than a formatting one -- recorded here so it is visible instead of absent.
